facts.fact: The EPF interest rate for FY 2025-26 is 8.25% per annum (recommended by the EPFO CBT), not 8.5%
facts.quote: After due deliberations, CBT recommended 8.25 % annual rate of interest to be credited on EPF accumulations in members’ accounts for the financial year 2025-26.

facts.fact: The 8.25% rate was recommended at the 239th CBT meeting, published by PIB on 2 Mar 2026
facts.quote: Posted On: 02 MAR 2026 3:37PM by PIB Delhi Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 239th meeting of Central Board of Trustees (CBT)

facts.fact: EPFO has officially notified the 8.25% rate for FY 2025-26
facts.quote: Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation, EPFO has officially notified an 8.25 percent interest rate on EPF deposits for financial year 2025-26.

summary: 8.25% for FY 2025-26 confirmed on PIB (239th CBT, 2 Mar 2026) and its notification on newsonair (1 Jul 2026).
